conflict_resolutions.PARTIAL_OR_QUALIFIED_CHANGE_REQUIRES_CLA: Resolved only as to current status by the identified later source’s express revocation of the parent order as amended, effective 1999-09-30. This does not establish whether the amended commission had already terminated earlier; its triggering report submission (and any extension) is unproved.

rationale: Provisional NO as of 2026-10-14: EO 13037 §5 as amended by EO 13108 fixes the Commission termination date at September 30, 1999; EO 13138 §3(d), §9 also expressly revokes EO 13037 as amended by EO 13108 effective September 30, 1999. Earlier first cessation is unresolved: EO 13037 §5 as amended establishes fixed termination September 30, 1999. EO 13108 §3 changes report deadline to February 1, 1999 and §5 changes termination phrase to fixed date. Actual report submission date was not established and may be an earlier trigger only if supported; that event remains unlocated. Read later order text and exact held original; status conclusion is separate from whole-lifecycle conclusion.
notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
